# What's new in 1.3.4

Released **2026-10-10**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Plan form.** Hours, session counts, and rest days stay saved. Quitting from Home no longer replaces them with the factory values. If that already happened, opening Plan restores them from the active plan.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-1.3.4-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v1.3.4
